manifest.lock_text: The arena's gatekeeper only honors the mark — and your codex doesn't hold that page yet.
manifest.name: Arena Gauntlet
nodes.A-0.edges.0.label: Loadout ready — step into the ring
nodes.A-0.summary: One by one the oil lamps of the underground scribing hall light up. The ring master strikes the ink gong: three bouts back to back, no rest between — you settle for however far you get.
nodes.A-0.title: Night Bouts in the Scribing Hall
nodes.A-1.edges.0.label: Press on (bout two, no rest)
nodes.A-1.edges.1.label: Quit while ahead (settle on one win)
nodes.A-1.summary: Three half-formed Ink Imps are driven into the ring and squirm their way toward you.
nodes.A-1.title: Bout One · The Imp Pack
nodes.A-2.edges.0.label: Press on (final bout, no rest)
nodes.A-2.edges.1.label: Quit while ahead (settle on two wins)
nodes.A-2.summary: The ink rain hasn't dried before a full-grown Ink Fiend steps over the imps' remains, a black tide churning in its chest.
nodes.A-2.title: Bout Two · The Ink Fiend
nodes.A-3.edges.0.label: Take a flawless bow
nodes.A-3.summary: Top of the bill is a retired Page Warden elite. He spreads his arms like seals on a scroll: "Let's see how much ink your page has left."
nodes.A-3.title: Final Bout · The Page Warden Elite
nodes.A-END.summary: The ink gong sounds again and the ring master records your result. However far you got, the scribing hall keeps a lamp lit for you.
nodes.A-END.title: Gauntlet Results
